scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
cabinet_approval: 2020-03-20 (per MeitY notification of 23.09.2021: 'approved by Union Cabinet on 20.03.2020'); corresponding PIB release PRID 1607487 carries a posting date of 2020-03-21, most likely a next-day posting
application_window: Round 1 closed 2020-07-31 (opening date NOT stated in the gazette); Round 2 (specified electronic components) 2021-03-11 to 2021-03-31
first_incremental_sales_year: FY2020-21 (Year 1); electable as FY2021-22 under the 23.09.2021 amendment
primary_date_rationale: The gazette itself names an operational date distinct from any fiscal-year boundary — para 10.5: 'Incentives under the Scheme will be applicable from 01.08.2020.' This is the earliest date from which incremental sales accrue toward an incentive claim, which is the principle applied uniformly across all four sectors.
sensitivity_date_2: 2021-08 (elected Year 1 under the 23.09.2021 amendment; also the COVID-robustness intervention date)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Pharmaceuticals [with the earlier PLI for KSMs/DIs/APIs as the companion scheme]
ministry: Department of Pharmaceuticals (Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers)
cabinet_approval: 2021-02-24 (Pharmaceuticals PLI); bulk-drugs PLI gazette says 'approved by the Government of India on 20th March 2020' — Government-approval wording not explicitly 'Cabinet'
application_window: NOT ESTABLISHED for the Pharmaceuticals PLI; bulk-drugs window was 120 days from notification
operational_effective_date: No separate 'effective from' clause; scheme duration FY2020-21 to FY2028-29 with an optional one-year gestation in FY2021-22
primary_date_rationale: Both schemes begin paying on incremental sales in FY2022-23. Pharmaceuticals PLI para 3.3: incentive 'on incremental sales (over base year) ... will be 10% for FY 2022-23 to FY 2025-26'. Bulk-drugs PLI para 4.2: chemical-synthesis products incentivised 'for FY 2022-23 to FY 2027-28'. April 2022 is the first month of that first performance year.
sensitivity_date_2: 2023-04 (fermentation route first incentive year per bulk-drugs para 4.1)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for White Goods (Air Conditioners and LED Lights) Manufacturers in India
operational_effective_date: First year of INVESTMENT is FY2021-22 (distinct from the sales year)
primary_date_rationale: Notification para 4.2 verbatim: 'The first year of investment will be FY 2021-22 and the first year of incremental sale will be FY 2022-23.' The scheme itself draws the distinction, so the incremental-sales year is the unambiguous binding date.
sensitivity_date_1: 2021-04 (first investment year — tests whether capacity build-out moved exports before sales incentives began)
sensitivity_date_2: 2023-04 (FY2023-24 for applicants electing the two-year gestation option)

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles
cabinet_approval: NOT STATED on any primary source; PIB announced the approval on 2021-09-08 (PRID 1753118) but neither the release nor the notification gives a calendar approval date
notification_ref: F. No. 12015/03/2020-IT; notification para 10: 'This notification shall come into force from the date of issuance.'
operational_effective_date: 2021-09-24 (notification in force from date of issuance)
base_year: NO BASE YEAR — the scheme pays on absolute turnover in Year 1 and on >=25% incremental turnover thereafter
primary_date_rationale: Notification para 7 framework table: performance year 1 = FY2024-2025 with claim year FY2025-2026. Gestation runs FY2022-23 to FY2023-24 (para 6). April 2024 is the first month of the first performance year.
sensitivity_date_2: 2022-04 (start of the two-year gestation period — the date from which qualifying investment had to begin) — memo S2

scheme_official_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme to Promote Telecom and Networking Products Manufacturing in India
application_window: 2021-06-04 to 2021-07-03 (the widely repeated '1 April to 3 May 2021' window is WRONG — 1 April 2021 is the effective date)
operational_effective_date: 2021-04-01 (notification para 6: 'The scheme will be effective from 1st April 2021')
base_year: FY2019-20 for sales; investment baseline as on 2021-03-31
primary_date_rationale: Dropped at the sector-selection stage. Recorded here so the exclusion is documented and the dates are preserved if the sector is ever revisited. Reasons: HS-8 line selection is analyst judgement (the notification lists products, not codes); 36 pre-months support at most 1 rolling-origin validation at h=12, so the forecasting counterfactual cannot be validated.
